radios.name: TYT MD-9600

bootloader: Disconnect the radio's DC power cable (the power key alone is not enough) and connect the USB cable to the mini-USB port on the rear.
Hold P1 and the orange (alarm) key while you connect the power again. The screen stays blank and the backlight blinks once a second.
Release the keys.
flash.notice: One image serves every MD-9600, but only V1-V3 boards (original firmware V06.xx) have run RadioFoundry so far. V4 (V16.xx) and V4A/V5 (V26.xx) boards have not been tried on a radio: receive or transmit may not work. Transmit stays off until you turn it on in Settings > Advanced > Hardware. Keep a backup so you can go back to the original firmware, and please report what you find.

unsupported_reasons.FONT_AA: a monochrome panel draws anti-aliased fonts as plain ink and gains nothing
unsupported_reasons.NAND_STORAGE: the data flash is SPI NOR
unsupported_reasons.FAULT_TRACE: needs a host UART: the host port is USB, and the one UART is the GPS receive line
unsupported_reasons.FONT_BIG: the 9x18 font is drawn only on panels 220 px and wider

not_written_reasons.RX_EXT: no receive range in its chip documents (a PLL and an IF chain, no single receiver chip)

radios.support: One image serves every board revision. On a V1-V3 radio, FM and DMR on both bands, DMR voice and data, text messages, roaming, scan, dual watch, APRS, the hotspot, each split duplex half and the USB network services work on air, with every power level checked on a wattmeter on both bands. V4A/V5 boards are detected; on older boards the radio asks for the revision once. Open: V4 and V4A/V5 boards have not run on a radio, and SFR loses inbound voice frames.

default_off.NET_PPP: Off by default on this radio due to a hardware flaw: if the computer and the radio send at the same time, the cable's PTT and serial line can lock up until the radio is switched off and on.
default_off.HOTSPOT: Off by default on this radio due to a hardware flaw: if the computer and the radio send at the same time, the cable's PTT and serial line may lock up until the radio is switched off and on.
default_off.DMR_GPS: Off by default on this radio: it has no GPS receiver or display, so it has no position to send or show.
default_off.DMR_LRRP: Off by default on this radio: it has no GPS receiver, so it could only answer that it has no position.

radios.support: Boots from the boot ROM with the host link, stub entry, the watchdog and the crash log. FM receive with CTCSS/DCS decode, FM transmit, DMR transmit and receive with the radio's own codec, P25 (conventional, and trunked transmit) and NXDN at 4800 bit/s on stored channels, and APRS transmit work on the radio.
